import pytest
from inventory import add_item, remove_item, total_items

def test_add_new_item():
    assert add_item([], 'apple', 3) == [{'name': 'apple', 'qty': 3}]

def test_add_existing_item():
    items = [{'name': 'apple', 'qty': 2}]
    assert add_item(items, 'apple', 1) == [{'name': 'apple', 'qty': 3}]

def test_remove_item():
    items = [{'name': 'apple', 'qty': 5}]
    remove_item(items, 'apple', 2)
    assert items == [{'name': 'apple', 'qty': 3}]

def test_total_items():
    items = [{'name': 'apple', 'qty': 2}, {'name': 'banana', 'qty': 3}]
    assert total_items(items) == 5
